research_question: How do forms, consequential review, and Undo preserve an executable path to completion without excessive confirmation?
acceptance: Correctable errors identify affected fields and a remedy while preserving valid work
A changed reviewed input invalidates the previous review without discarding unrelated input
Choose prevention/review/reversal based on consequence and actual capability, not one global confirmation rule
Undo that is pending, failed or expired never presents restoration as completed
Cancellation, compensating business action, and local edit reversal remain distinct
cases: Multi-field application with one server-rejected field
Edit from review and return without answering unrelated questions again
Locally reversible archive; restore race or expired Undo offer
verification: Executable state/event conformance plus independent critic; human comprehension and assistive tech not measured
scope_boundary: C owns DOM focus/live announcement mechanics; B states the user-visible correction and return-path requirements
